farmer.evidence: Wide straw hat with red band, big hoe; unique

miner.evidence: Yellow lamp helmet and pickaxe clear at 40; tiny yellow dot at 170

woodcutter.evidence: Orange beanie and big axe; orange dot at 170, axe small

blacksmith.evidence: Dark hat with orange band, hammer; dark body blends with shadow

merchant.evidence: Purple outfit and cap, long gold scale beam

healer.evidence: White hat with green cross; staff thin, white blends with farmer

soldier.evidence: Silver helmet, red crest, tall spear with banner

builder.evidence: Teal cap and mallet; mallet small at distance

hauler.evidence: Blue beret, sack on back; reads only from behind

idle.evidence: Plain brown hair, no prop, near-identical to variation citizens

governor.evidence: Gold crown spikes and gold staff, all-red robe; reads like soldier from above

defects: Aerial 170 (sheet_aerial170, sheet_lineup170): at about 10 px only hat colour dots separate jobs; tools and hats are too small, and most of the crowd is still red, brown and beige.

Silhouettes (sheet_silhouettes): builder, hauler, idle, healer and blacksmith have near-identical torso and head outlines. Their props are thin or small, and the 50-degree top-down silhouettes are almost indistinguishable.

Idle citizen (sheet_identities, sheet_lineup170): no hat or tool, so it is confused with the generic variation citizens. Hauler and builder are weak in front view; the hauler's sack shows only from behind.

Same-job variation (sheet_variation): the only differences are skin, hair colour and an occasional stripe. Hair and head silhouettes are alike and there are no accessories, so variation does not reach the 4 threshold.

Kingdom red mantle (sheet_aerial170, sheet_gameplay40): hat colours compete with the red shoulders and the mantle is small. Soldier and governor both read as red from above, and blacksmith and healer blend into shadow or the other white and brown characters.
notes: The After kit is a real improvement in colour and hat identity. Farmer, merchant and soldier read well, and woodcutter, miner and builder are helped by their new hat colours. It still does not meet the silhouette, variation and readability thresholds of 4: idle, hauler, builder, blacksmith and healer remain weak at 170 studs, and citizens of the same job barely differ. It needs larger props, more distinct head and body outlines, and per-citizen accessories before launch.
